behavior_summary.classifier: MMSChatErrorClassifier (163 lines) classifies errors into 3 categories: bridgeMismatch (RPC code -32601 or combined-fragment check: any fragment contains 'mmschat/' AND any fragment contains hint like 'unsupported'/'missing'/'not found'/'not supported'/'unknown method'/'not implemented'), disconnected (CodexServiceError.disconnected or connection-lost fragments), other (generic fallback). Combined-fragment logic resolves reviewer HIGH finding about split data: { method: 'mmschat/list', reason: 'not supported' } where method and reason appear in separate SSE fragments.
behavior_summary.classifier_tests: MMSChatErrorClassifierTests (88 lines) covers direct RPCError cases, wrapped CodexServiceError.rpcError cases, split method/reason data direct RPCError, and wrapped split-fragment scenarios. Includes tests for bridgeMismatch, disconnected, and other categories.
behavior_summary.localization: 3 new keys added in both zh-Hans and en: mmschat.error_bridge_mismatch (advises updating Mac Bridge and re-pairing), mmschat.error_connection_lost (advises confirming Mac is online and restarting Bridge), mmschat.error_generic (temporarily unavailable, retry later).
behavior_summary.view_sites: 11 error catch sites across MMSChatListView (list load, demo seed, hide), MMSChatDetailView (detail load, open visible, hide session, clear cache, resume, send stop), and MMSChatLaunchPlanSheetView (load metadata, load plan) now route through MMSChatErrorClassifier.localizedMessage(for:) instead of raw error.localizedDescription.
